raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Dynamic EPLB migrates expert weights between ranks with NCCL point-to-point operations.

The Humming/MXFP4 MoE backend stores some expert scale tensors as `torch.float8_e8m0fnu`. PyTorch's NCCL process group cannot send or receive this dtype directly, so the first dynamic EPLB rebalance fails with:

```text
TypeError: Input tensor data type is not supported for NCCL process group:
Float8_e8m0fnu
```

The tensor payload is byte-addressable and does not require numerical conversion during migration.

## Modifications

- Add `_get_p2p_transport_tensor()` to return a zero-copy `torch.uint8` view for `torch.float8_e8m0fnu` tensors.
- Apply the transport view symmetrically to EPLB P2P send and receive buffers.
- Leave NCCL-supported tensor dtypes and tensor objects unchanged.
- Add a registered CPU unit test covering:
  - E8M0 tensors use a `uint8` transport view;
  - the transport view shares the original storage;
  - the E8M0 byte pattern is preserved;
  - writes through a receive-side view update the original tensor;
  - supported dtypes are returned unchanged.

This changes only the transport representation. It does not cast, requantize, or alter the expert tensor contents.

## Accuracy Tests

End-to-end smoke test:

- Model: DeepSeek-V4-Pro
- GPU: H20
- MoE runner backend: Humming
- MoE A2A backend: DeepEP
- Dynamic EPLB: enabled
- GSM8K samples: 20

```text
Accuracy: 0.950
Invalid: 0.000
Latency: 15.308 s
Output throughput: 136.723 token/s
```

The test completed after dynamic EPLB migration without the previous NCCL dtype failure.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No steady-state inference path is changed. The helper creates a zero-copy dtype view only while constructing dynamic EPLB migration P2P operations:

```python
tensor.view(torch.uint8)
```

It performs no allocation or data conversion. Therefore no steady-state throughput regression is expected. The end-to-end smoke test above confirms successful inference with dynamic EPLB enabled.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (No user-facing behavior or configuration is changed.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -35,6 +35,13 @@
 _LOG_INPUT = get_bool_env_var("SGLANG_EXPERT_LOCATION_UPDATER_LOG_INPUT")
 
 
+def _get_p2p_transport_tensor(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Return an NCCL-compatible view without changing the tensor's bytes."""
+    if tensor.dtype == torch.float8_e8m0fnu:
+        return tensor.view(torch.uint8)
+    return tensor
+
+
 class ExpertLocationUpdater:
     def __init__(self):
         self._first_execution = True
@@ -354,7 +361,9 @@ def _create_p2p_recv_and_buffer2weight_copy(
                 [
                     P2POp(
                         op=torch.distributed.irecv,
-                        tensor=_get_tensor(temp_buffers, i, dst_expert_location),
+                        tensor=_get_p2p_transport_tensor(
+                            _get_tensor(temp_buffers, i, dst_expert_location)
+                        ),
                         peer=src_rank,
                     )
                     for i in range(num_tensors)
@@ -402,8 +411,8 @@ def _create_isend_ops_of_logical_expert_id(
                 [
                     P2POp(
                         op=torch.distributed.isend,
-                        tensor=_get_tensor(
-                            routed_experts_weights, i, src_expert_location
+                        tensor=_get_p2p_transport_tensor(
+                            _get_tensor(routed_experts_weights, i, src_expert_location)
                         ),
                         peer=dst_rank,
                     )

@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.eplb.expert_location_updater import _get_p2p_transport_tensor
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=3, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def test_e8m0_p2p_transport_uses_bit_preserving_uint8_view():
+    raw = torch.tensor([0x00, 0x7F, 0x80, 0xFF], dtype=torch.uint8)
+    tensor = raw.view(torch.float8_e8m0fnu)
+
+    transport = _get_p2p_transport_tensor(tensor)
+
+    assert transport.dtype == torch.uint8
+    assert transport.data_ptr() == tensor.data_ptr()
+    assert torch.equal(transport, raw)
+
+    transport[1] = 0x42
+    assert tensor.view(torch.uint8)[1].item() == 0x42
+
+
+def test_supported_p2p_transport_dtype_is_unchanged():
+    tensor = torch.arange(4, dtype=torch.float32)
+
+    transport = _get_p2p_transport_tensor(tensor)
+
+    assert transport is tensor
